paper_findings.text: SIBAL cloth burns like cotton but maintains structural integrity after the cotton is consumed.
The flame spread rate increased with flow speed for PMMA samples in concurrent flow.
The flame spread rate was independent of flow speed at higher flow speeds for thin-fuel samples.
The flame spread rate was faster in upward flame spread compared to downward flame spread for silicone samples.
The flame propagates or self-extinguishes in the composite fabric sample in 21% O2 mole fraction.
